svg.title: The complete nine-node seven-edge DAG that test 3 protects
svg.desc: A directed acyclic graph showing the complete causal architecture documented in Table 4 of the M6 capstone report, with nine nodes arranged in three columns and seven directed edges; the five edges from Test 2's CAUSAL_EDGES dictionary form the core information flow at top and bottom, and two new edges from MACRO and REGIME both pointing into RISK represent the exogenous conditioning that Test 3 newly enforces.
svg.text: Test 3 — the full 9-node, 7-edge architecture from Table 4
Edges 1–5: core information flow (same as Test 2's CAUSAL_EDGES dict).
Edges 6 and 7: exogenous conditioning — MACRO and REGIME feed RISK but are not caused by any other node.
Purple nodes (MACRO, REGIME) are the two newcomers that Test 3 enforces beyond what Test 2 protects.
This is the figure that appears in Table 4 of the M6 capstone report — "nine nodes, seven directed edges."
